name: Gastronomy Tour – Taste of Mostar
tagline: A food walk through the Old Town with local tastings, traditional sweets and Bosnian coffee.
level: Easy: short walks on uneven streets
meetingPoint: Parking area next to the Hamam
description: Get to know Mostar through the food people prepare, share and serve. The route combines a guided walk with selected tastings, seasonal products and Bosnian coffee. Depending on the day and the agreed menu, you may try traditional sweets, local juices, market products and a traditional dish.

itinerary.text: A homemade seasonal juice, if arranged.
Walk through the Old Town and stop for a traditional savoury bite.
Continue through the historic area and Kujundžiluk with a tasting of Bosnian sweets.
Visit the market when it is open and seasonal produce is available.
Taste Bosnian coffee and learn about its preparation and customs.
A traditional meal, as part of a longer version confirmed in advance.

included: Tastings listed in your confirmed offer
notIncluded: Tastings not listed in the written offer
practical: Tell us about allergies and dietary needs when you enquire.
notes: Is the Gastronomy Tour 2 hours (current offer) or about 4 hours (old document)?
